title: OpenAttention: One Percent Is Enough with Tail Proxies
abstract: arXiv:2610.30951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse attention reads only a small subset of the key-value cache, and how to treat the unread tail remains a key challenge. Discarding the tail biases the output, and sampling it as previous approaches do fails at reads of 5% and below, where the tail likely holds heavy hitters the selector missed. Our key observation is that the simplest possible proxy, one token that folds the entire tail into its count-aware mean, already yields lower output error than a sample at every read behind a practical selector. We further show in closed form that at low reads sampling nearly doubles the weight error of discarding while a single proxy stays below it. Building on these findings, we explore approximating the dense attention distribution with a few proxies that target the tail. translated_title: OpenAttention：用尾部代理，百分之一足矣
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30951v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：稀疏注意力只读取键值缓存中的一小部分，而如何处理未被读取的尾部仍然是一个关键挑战。直接丢弃尾部会使输出产生偏差，而以往方法采用的尾部采样策略在读取率为5%及以下时会失效，因为此时尾部很可能包含选择器遗漏的重要token。我们的关键观察是，最简单的代理形式——一个将整个尾部折叠为其计数感知均值的token——在实用选择器下的每个读取率上，都能产生比采样更低的输出误差。我们进一步以闭式形式证明，在低读取率下，采样带来的权重误差几乎是丢弃的两倍，而单个代理的误差则始终低于丢弃。基于这些发现，我们探索用少量针对尾部的代理来近似稠密注意力分布。我们提出了OpenAttention，这是一个由聚类、ErrorGate和top-k选择加上计数感知均值代理组成的流水线。为了高效地实现聚类和选择……
tldr: OpenAttention通过将整个未读尾部压缩为单个计数感知均值代理token，在读取率低至1%时仍能获得比丢弃或采样更低误差的稀疏注意力输出。
